message: Astra: Within this investigation, does “otherwise will be dangerous” identify anything that actually prevents the characters from proceeding? Where would closer reading distinguish a warning from an interruption? Would more thinking clarify that distinction enough to repay its time, or would a drafting attempt teach you more? What unresolved uncertainty favors thinking first, and what evidence would justify either choice? Could you briefly name what your draft establishes, what remains uncertain, and your chosen next step in English, then pursue it?
